column1: # Empty context = plain UI string (tl!, t).
# @plural = plural forms: one|other in English, one form for Turkish.
# Clean-room: written from the meaning of ArtCraft Launcher's English labels in neutral Turkish,
# using the terms Turkish-speaking users of Windows, macOS and creative software know (Yükle,
# Kaldır, Güncelle, İndir, Sürüm notları). The user is addressed with the polite "siz" form, and
# buttons are plain imperatives, as in most current Turkish software.
# Coverage: the whole interface — every menu string and tl! literal (complete_menus = true).
# Left in English on purpose: product name "ArtCraft Launcher" (and its "Launcher" tag), suite
# app names (PhotoCraft, LightCraft, FilmCraft, DesignCraft, VectorCraft, PdfCraft, EffectCraft,
# Shortcut keys keep their key-cap names (Esc).
# A placeholder never takes a case suffix: Turkish suffixes follow the vowels of the word they
# join, which a placeholder doesn't know ("{name} güncellendi: {version}", not "{version}'e").
# Turkish nouns stay singular after a number ("3 uygulama"), so there is one plural form.
# Upper-case labels dot the capital i (İNDİR), except in the names that stay in English
